{{field-1}} $+C$"] [:db/add "e1dc1856-8570-5f0a-89ab-959e51200fe2" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=x^{3}$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=3 x^{2}.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int - 9 x^{2} \cot{\left(x^{3} \right)} \csc{\left(x^{3} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=-3\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}

$$
-3\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3 \csc{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$

{{field-1}} $+C$"] [:db/add "bd8c81ba-30ea-501d-a51f-626a1c33904a" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x^{3}$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=9 x^{2}.
$$

Substituting, including the required constant factor, gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 18 x^{2} \cot{\left(3 x^{3} \right)} \csc{\left(3 x^{3} \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

$$
2\left(\int \cot{\left(u \right)} \csc{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- 2 \csc{\left(u \right)}+C.
